clause: ICC color management (working spaces / policies / assign / convert / embed) [STU-COL-004]

scope.summary: A StudioColorProfile binds an ICC profile. Support document working spaces per model (RGB/CMYK/Gray/spot), color-management policies for profile mismatches on open/paste, embedding the profile on export, assign-profile (retag without changing values), and convert-to-profile (change values to a destination profile with a chosen rendering intent). Wide-gamut working spaces are supported as ordinary ICC profiles (PS Color Settings + Assign/Convert + embed; AF ICC assign/convert; ID pipeline, deduped). Operator color-settings + model command.
acceptance_criteria: working spaces, mismatch policies, embed-on-export, assign (retag) vs convert (intent) profile; wide-gamut ICC
expected_tests: live: working-space per model + mismatch policy on open/paste + embed-on-export
test: assign-profile retags without changing values; convert-to-profile changes values with chosen intent; wide-gamut as ICC

risk_if_missed: No ICC management; color fidelity + prepress unmet.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
